exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Lie on bench, grip bar slightly wider than shoulder width, lower to chest, press up.

exercises.name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Set bench to 30-45 degrees, grip bar shoulder width, lower to upper chest, press up.

exercises.name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Set bench to decline, secure legs, grip bar shoulder width, lower to lower chest, press up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Lie on bench with dumbbells, press up with palms facing forward, lower to chest level.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.instructions: Set bench to 30-45 degrees, press dumbbells up from shoulder level.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Fly
exercises.instructions: Lie on bench, arms extended above chest, lower dumbbells in an arc to sides, squeeze back up.

exercises.name: Cable Crossover
exercises.instructions: Stand between cable towers, pull handles down and together in front of chest.

exercises.name: Machine Chest Press
exercises.instructions: Sit on machine, grip handles at chest level, press forward, return controlled.

exercises.name: Push Up
exercises.instructions: Hands shoulder-width apart, lower chest to ground, push back up keeping body straight.

exercises.name: Dip
exercises.instructions: Grip parallel bars, lean forward slightly, lower body until upper arms are parallel, press up.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.instructions: Bar on upper back, feet shoulder width, squat down until thighs parallel, drive up through heels.

exercises.name: Front Squat
exercises.instructions: Bar racked on front delts, elbows high, squat to depth maintaining upright torso.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.instructions: Hold dumbbell at chest, feet shoulder width, squat down keeping chest up.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.instructions: Sit in leg press, feet shoulder width on platform, lower weight, press back up.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.instructions: Sit on machine, pad against shins, extend legs fully, lower controlled.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.instructions: Rear foot on bench, front foot forward, lower until front thigh parallel, press up.
common_mistakes: Front foot too close to bench

exercises.name: Hack Squat
exercises.instructions: Stand on platform, shoulders under pads, squat down and press up.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
exercises.instructions: Step forward, lower back knee toward ground, push off front foot, step forward with other leg.

exercises.name: Conventional Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Stand with feet hip-width, grip bar outside knees, drive through heels, stand tall.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Hold bar at hips, slight knee bend, hinge at hips lowering bar along legs, feel hamstring stretch.

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Wide stance, toes out, grip inside knees, drive through heels, stand tall.

exercises.name: Leg Curl
exercises.instructions: Lie face down on machine, curl pad toward glutes, lower controlled.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.instructions: Sit on machine, pad behind ankles, curl down, control the return.

exercises.name: Good Morning
exercises.instructions: Bar on upper back, slight knee bend, hinge forward at hips until torso near parallel.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
exercises.instructions: Upper back on bench, bar over hips, drive hips up squeezing glutes, lower controlled.

exercises.name: Cable Pull Through
exercises.instructions: Face away from low cable, reach between legs, hinge and drive hips forward.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.instructions: Stand on edge of platform, rise up on toes, lower below parallel for full stretch.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
exercises.instructions: Sit with pad on knees, rise up on toes, lower for full stretch.

exercises.name: Overhead Press
exercises.instructions: Bar at collar bone, feet shoulder width, press straight up overhead, lower controlled.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.instructions: Seated or standing, dumbbells at shoulder height, press overhead, lower controlled.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
exercises.instructions: Stand with dumbbells at sides, raise arms to sides until parallel with floor.

exercises.name: Front Raise
exercises.instructions: Stand with dumbbells in front, raise one or both arms to eye level, lower controlled.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.instructions: High cable with rope, pull toward face separating rope ends, squeeze rear delts.

exercises.name: Reverse Pec Deck
exercises.instructions: Sit facing pad, grip handles, open arms pulling back squeezing rear delts.

exercises.name: Upright Row
exercises.instructions: Narrow grip on bar, pull up along body to chin level, elbows leading.

exercises.name: Barbell Row
exercises.instructions: Hinge forward, grip bar shoulder width, pull to lower chest/upper abs, lower controlled.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Row
exercises.instructions: One hand and knee on bench, row dumbbell to hip, squeeze lat at top.

exercises.name: Pull Up
exercises.instructions: Hang from bar overhand grip, pull chin above bar, lower with control.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.instructions: Wide grip on bar, pull to upper chest, squeeze lats, return controlled.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.instructions: Sit at cable station, pull handle to lower chest, squeeze shoulder blades, return controlled.

exercises.name: T-Bar Row
exercises.instructions: Straddle bar, hinge forward, pull toward chest, squeeze back, lower controlled.

exercises.name: Cable Lat Pullover
exercises.instructions: Stand at high cable, straight arms, pull bar down in arc to thighs, squeeze lats.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
exercises.instructions: Stand with barbell, curl weight up keeping elbows at sides, lower controlled.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
exercises.instructions: Stand with dumbbells, curl up with palms forward, squeeze at top, lower controlled.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.instructions: Stand with dumbbells, palms facing each other, curl up maintaining neutral grip.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl
exercises.instructions: Sit at preacher bench, upper arms on pad, curl bar up, lower controlled.

exercises.name: Concentration Curl
exercises.instructions: Sit with elbow against inner thigh, curl dumbbell up, squeeze at top.

exercises.name: Cable Curl
exercises.instructions: Stand at low cable, curl bar up keeping elbows at sides, lower controlled.

exercises.name: Tricep Pushdown
exercises.instructions: Stand at high cable, push bar/rope down straightening arms, control return.

exercises.name: Overhead Tricep Extension
exercises.instructions: Hold dumbbell overhead with both hands, lower behind head, extend back up.

exercises.name: Skull Crusher
exercises.instructions: Lie on bench, bar overhead, lower to forehead by bending elbows, extend back up.

exercises.name: Close Grip Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Lie on bench, grip bar shoulder width or narrower, lower to lower chest, press up.

exercises.name: Tricep Kickback
exercises.instructions: Hinge forward, upper arm parallel to floor, extend forearm back, squeeze tricep.

exercises.name: Diamond Push Up
exercises.instructions: Hands together forming diamond, lower chest to hands, push back up.

exercises.name: Barbell Shrug
exercises.instructions: Hold barbell at thighs, shrug shoulders straight up toward ears, hold and lower.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shrug
exercises.instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides, shrug shoulders up, hold briefly, lower controlled.

exercises.name: Crunch
exercises.instructions: Lie on back, hands behind head, curl upper body up contracting abs.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.instructions: Forearms on ground, body straight from head to heels, hold position.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.instructions: Hang from bar, raise legs to parallel or above, lower controlled.

exercises.name: Cable Woodchop
exercises.instructions: Stand sideways to cable, rotate torso pulling cable diagonally across body.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
exercises.instructions: Sit with knees bent, lean back slightly, rotate torso side to side.

exercises.name: Ab Rollout
exercises.instructions: Kneel with ab wheel, roll forward extending body, pull back using abs.

exercises.name: Mountain Climber
exercises.instructions: Plank position, alternate driving knees toward chest rapidly.

exercises.name: Farmer's Walk
exercises.instructions: Hold heavy dumbbells at sides, walk with upright posture for distance or time.

exercises.name: Wrist Curl
exercises.instructions: Sit with forearms on thighs, palms up, curl bar up using only wrists.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Stand in hex bar, grip handles, drive through heels to stand tall.

exercises.name: Machine Row
exercises.instructions: Sit at machine, pull handles to torso, squeeze back, return controlled.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Squat
exercises.instructions: Bar on upper back in Smith machine, feet slightly forward, squat to depth.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
exercises.instructions: Stand sideways to low cable, raise arm to side until parallel, lower controlled.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
exercises.instructions: Sit on incline bench, arms hanging, curl dumbbells up, squeeze at top.

exercises.name: EZ Bar Curl
exercises.instructions: Grip EZ bar at angles, curl up keeping elbows stationary, lower controlled.

exercises.name: Chest Supported Dumbbell Row
exercises.instructions: Lie chest-down on incline bench, row dumbbells up squeezing back.

exercises.name: Single Leg Romanian Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Stand on one leg, hinge forward lowering dumbbell, extend back leg behind.

exercises.name: Glute Kickback
exercises.instructions: Attach ankle cuff to low cable, kick leg straight back squeezing glute.

exercises.name: Pendlay Row
exercises.instructions: Torso parallel, bar on floor each rep, explosively row to lower chest.

exercises.name: Meadows Row
exercises.instructions: Stand perpendicular to landmine, staggered stance, row bar to hip.

exercises.name: Deficit Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Stand on 2-4 inch platform, conventional deadlift with increased range of motion.

exercises.name: Pause Squat
exercises.instructions: Back squat with 2-3 second pause at bottom position before driving up.

exercises.name: Box Squat
exercises.instructions: Squat to box, briefly sit, drive up explosively.

exercises.name: Leg Press Calf Raise
exercises.instructions: Position feet low on leg press, extend and flex ankles through full range.

exercises.name: Cable Reverse Fly
exercises.instructions: Cross cables at shoulder height, pull apart opening arms, squeeze rear delts.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Pullover
exercises.instructions: Lie across bench, hold dumbbell overhead, lower behind head in arc, pull back up.

exercises.name: Rack Pull
exercises.instructions: Set bar at knee height in rack, pull to lockout focusing on back contraction.

exercises.name: Sissy Squat
exercises.instructions: Hold support, lean back bending only at knees, lower hips toward heels.

exercises.name: Bench Dip
exercises.instructions: Hands on bench behind you, lower body by bending elbows, press back up.

exercises.name: Inverted Row
exercises.instructions: Hang under bar with feet on ground, pull chest to bar, lower controlled.

exercises.name: Step Up
exercises.instructions: Step onto box/bench, drive through front foot to stand, lower controlled.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
exercises.instructions: Step backward, lower back knee toward ground, push back to standing.

exercises.name: Glute Ham Raise
exercises.instructions: Lock feet in GHD, lower torso forward, curl back up using hamstrings.

exercises.name: Sumo Squat
exercises.instructions: Wide stance, toes out, hold dumbbell at center, squat down, drive up.

exercises.name: Machine Shoulder Press
exercises.instructions: Sit at machine, grip handles, press overhead, lower controlled.

exercises.name: Reverse Grip Lat Pulldown
exercises.instructions: Grip bar underhand shoulder width, pull to upper chest, squeeze lats.

exercises.name: Pec Deck
exercises.instructions: Sit at machine, forearms on pads, squeeze arms together, return controlled.

exercises.name: Decline Dumbbell Press
exercises.instructions: Lie on decline bench, press dumbbells up, lower to lower chest, press up.

exercises.name: Landmine Press
exercises.instructions: Hold end of barbell at shoulder, press up and slightly forward.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing
exercises.instructions: Hinge at hips, swing kettlebell between legs, drive hips to swing to chest height.

exercises.name: Turkish Get Up
exercises.instructions: Lie with KB overhead, stand up through specific sequence, reverse back down.

exercises.name: Reverse Curl
exercises.instructions: Grip barbell overhand, curl up keeping wrists straight, lower controlled.

exercises.name: Zottman Curl
exercises.instructions: Curl up supinated, rotate to pronated at top, lower with overhand grip.

exercises.name: Spider Curl
exercises.instructions: Lie chest on incline bench, arms hanging, curl dumbbells squeezing at top.

exercises.name: Decline Crunch
exercises.instructions: Lie on decline bench, cross arms or hold weight, crunch up contracting abs.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.instructions: Kneel at high cable, rope behind head, crunch down contracting abs.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.instructions: Lie on side, prop on forearm, lift hips creating straight line, hold.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.instructions: Lie on back, arms up, knees at 90, extend opposite arm and leg, return, alternate.

exercises.name: Pallof Press
exercises.instructions: Stand sideways to cable, hold handle at chest, press straight out, resist rotation.

exercises.name: Hip Adduction Machine
exercises.instructions: Sit on machine, squeeze legs together, control the return.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction Machine
exercises.instructions: Sit on machine, push legs apart against pads, control the return.

exercises.name: V-Up
exercises.instructions: Lie flat, simultaneously raise legs and torso to form V shape, lower controlled.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunch
exercises.instructions: Lie on back, alternate bringing elbow to opposite knee in pedaling motion.
